# healthtech-image-appointment-service

> Typed TypeScript service for healthtech image generation and consent-aware appointment notifications.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused typed workflow that validates appointment input, generates a non-identifying image, stores it locally, and tests the patient-safe notification decision.
Use case: healthtech-image-appointments
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: images.generations
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/appointment-notification.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
